evidence.title: Next.js Ecommerce Dashboard Template - Shadcn Admin

name: Next.js Ecommerce Dashboard Template
summary: Paid ecommerce admin template for Next.js with product, order, customer, analytics and messaging screens.
description: A complete ecommerce admin panel built with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS v4 and TypeScript on the Next.js App Router: dashboard, products, orders, filters, customers, analytics, messages and settings pages filled with sample data. One-time payment with full source code and lifetime updates.
contains: 8 admin pages: dashboard, products, orders, filters, customers, analytics, messages, settings
orders list with TanStack Table sorting and filtering
product catalog with create and detail flows
shadcn/ui components on Tailwind CSS v4, typed with TypeScript
light and dark mode, mobile-first layout
